topic: Asking for Help with the Gas Pump

script.title: ASKING FOR HELP WITH THE GAS PUMP
script.story_hook: The gas pump refuses my card on Monday morning.
script.intro_zh: 星期一早上，加油機不收我的卡。
script.welcome_en: Hey there, welcome back! Today: help at a cranky gas pump.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎回來！今天的主題：向罷工的加油機求助。
script.outro: Full tank, good mood, see you next time!
script.outro_zh: 油加滿、心情好，我們下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: read each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你跟著我，一句一句朗讀。

script.char_b_description: a white-haired older man in his early sixties with a gray mustache and a sun-weathered face, wearing a yellow station vest over plaid flannel, chewing on a toothpick

加油機一直吃卡、顯示拒絕怎麼辦？這段18句的加油站求助對話，教你描述刷卡故障、改用店內付款、換一臺加油機、找到柴油車道與免費空氣機。整段自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，開車出國自助旅行前必聽。

script.youtube_description_en:
Card keeps getting declined at the pump? This 18-line gas station conversation teaches you to describe the malfunction, switch to paying inside, move to another pump, and find the diesel lane and free air machine. Natural American English with IPA and translation, then repeat every line out loud in the second half. Perfect listening for a US road trip.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】⛽加油求助英文｜刷卡故障・店內付款・柴油車道指路｜聽完就會加油｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
在美國自駕，加油機卻一直拒絕你的卡？
英文怎麼問店員、怎麼改用店內付款？

這一集帶大家走進星期一早上的加油站，司機向老師傅店員描述刷卡故障，兩人一起換加油機、指路柴油車道、確認充氣機，還聊到手機支付，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
⛽ 描述故障：例如「pump five won't read my card」、「it keeps saying declined」。
💳 解決方案：例如「just pay inside at the counter」、「take number six」。
🚙 場地問路：例如「where's the diesel lane?」、「the tire air machine」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次公路旅行，加油的每句話你都聽得懂！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a card up to a stubborn gas pump

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, pump five won't read my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi pʌmp faɪv woʊnt rid maɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，五號加油機讀不到我的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that one's been acting up all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə wʌnz bɪn ˈæktɪŋ ʌp ɔl wik/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, it just keeps saying declined on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛ ɪt dʒʌst kips ˈseɪɪŋ dɪˈklaɪnd ɑn ðə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，螢幕上一直顯示付款拒絕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try pressing the button first, sometimes that helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ˈprɛsɪŋ ðə ˈbʌtən fɜrst ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ðæt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 你先把按鈕按下去看看，有時候那樣就有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did already. Um, any other way to pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd ɔlˈrɛdi ʌm ˈɛni ˈʌðər weɪ tə peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我按過了。呃，還有別的付款方法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just pay inside at the counter, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr dʒʌst peɪ ɪnˈsaɪd ət ðə ˈkaʊntər noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 可以的，直接到店內櫃台付款，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. And can I switch pumps out here?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd kæn aɪ swɪtʃ pʌmps aʊt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 好。那我可以在外面換一臺加油機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take number six, it's working fine today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs teɪk ˈnʌmbər sɪks ɪts ˈwɜrkɪŋ faɪn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，改用六號那臺，它今天運作正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. One more question, where's the diesel lane?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛstʃən wɛrz ðə ˈdizəl leɪn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。再問一件事，柴油車道在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back corner, right past the car wash there.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ˈkɔrnər raɪt pæst ðə kɑr wɑʃ ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 在後面角落，穿過那個洗車場就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Is the tire air machine working, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ɪz ðə ˈtaɪər ɛr məˈʃin ˈwɜrkɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 了解。輪胎充氣機也可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, it's free, right by the back wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ɪts fri raɪt baɪ ðə bæk wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 可以啊，那是免費的，就在後牆旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Do you take mobile pay inside as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs du ju teɪk ˈmoʊbəl peɪ ɪnˈsaɪd əz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 很好。店內也可以用手機支付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do. Cards and cash work too, of course.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du kɑrdz ænd kæʃ wɜrk tu ʌv ˈkɔrs/
dialogue.zh: 可以，信用卡和現金當然也都收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome, that solves everything. Thanks a bunch!
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈsɑm ðæt sɑlvz ˈɛvriθɪŋ θæŋks ə bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，問題全都解決了。真的非常感謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Sometimes the card readers hate Mondays.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ðə kɑrd ˈridərz heɪt ˈmʌndeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。刷卡機偶爾就是會鬧脾氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! True. Have a good one, I appreciate it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tru hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn aɪ əˈpriʃieɪt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，說得也是。祝你今天愉快，真的很感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, buddy. Drive safe out there!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ˈbʌdi draɪv seɪf aʊt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 你也是，老兄。開車一路順風！
